target: workflow.sh diff/merge — a plugin region whose body differs from BOTH the template and its stamped checksum is a conflict, is NOT overwritten, and refreshed stays empty
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/workflow-fixture.sh"; wf_file project.js '// header' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("v1 greeting");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// footer'; STAMP=$(workflow_sums project.js '//'); wf_file project.js '// header' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("v2 HAND EDITED greeting");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// footer'; wf_file template.js '// header' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("v3 upstream greeting");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// footer'; cp project.js expected.js; DIFF=$(workflow_diff project.js template.js '//' "$STAMP"); MERGE=$(workflow_merge project.js template.js '//' "$STAMP"); MATCH=$(cmp -s project.js expected.js && echo true || echo false); jq -n --argjson d "$DIFF" --argjson m "$MERGE" --argjson match "$MATCH" '{diff:$d, merge:$m, match:$match}'

checks.expr: .diff.conflict == [{"region":"greet","reason":"edited inside a plugin-owned region — refusing to overwrite"}]

_note: The core promise of region ownership: a hand edit inside a plugin region must never be silently clobbered by an upstream refresh, and must never be silently accepted as 'already current' either. STAMP is computed with workflow_sums on the true v1 body (what upstream actually shipped) BEFORE the hand edit, so v2 (the hand edit) differs from both the stamp (v1) and the template (v3) — the three-way condition the conflict branch exists for. Regresses xeneon-edge-mac's fork-drops-a-policy-clause failure this file's header documents.
